source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The changed test opens the actual link context menu and activates its save item. The accepted test resolves the picker defaultString and returns returnCancel, then expects Link to a web page. It checks that the command reaches the picker with the intended suggested name, not that bytes were downloaded or a file was written. A focused follow-up test for write completion would need separate file-content assertions and test-file cleanup. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: The Save Link regression test proves picker entry and filename selection
